## Constructing the Environments

● We need to push the system into a congested state for realistic waves ● Set a downstream boundary condition, max speed (5 m/s for I-210, 6 m/s for single lane highway) ● Run system for 600 seconds to get stable congestion before any control is applied

## Defining the Environments

Simulating a given penetration rate: for n% autonomy, every (100/n)th vehicle is replaced with a controllable agent (e.g. 10% autonomy → every 10th vehicle is an AV)

States: Speeds of the AVs and adjacent in-lane vehicles, as well as the gap between the AV and it’s leader / follower (concatenated into one observation for the single agent case)

Actions: desired acceleration by the AVs (list of acceleration for each AV in the centralized/single agent case)

## Multi-agent RL

## ● Fully decentralized

○ Observations are only local ○ Control is per-agent ● Every agent has a copy of the same controller ● Extremely efficient if task is primarily “local”
